from pathlib import Path
base=Path('/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    for color in set(v for row in grid for v in row)-{1}:
        pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==color]
        dirs=set()
        for i,(r,c) in enumerate(pts):
            for rr,cc in pts[i+1:]:
                dr,dc=rr-r,cc-c
                if abs(dr)==abs(dc) and dr:
                    dirs.add((1 if dr>0 else -1,1 if dc>0 else -1))
        if not dirs: continue
        # Extend the diagonal line through the most numerous diagonal direction pairs.
        for dr,dc in dirs:
            for r,c in pts:
                rr,cc=r-dr,c-dc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    if grid[rr][cc]==1: out[rr][cc]=color
                    rr-=dr; cc-=dc
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    if grid[rr][cc]==1: out[rr][cc]=color
                    rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    return out
'''
(base/'task-fb366191.py').write_text(code)
